purpose: Capture complete existing Beat This! final0 beat/downbeat f32 logits without changing legacy events; no musical scoring or new decoder.

capture.inference: Reuse unchanged apta_1_1_neural_inference.Models including its synthetic preflight, loading/reset behavior, CPU two threads, final0 checkpoint, canonical PCM48k stereo f32 read, numpy channel mean and soxr HQ to 22050 Hz. Wrap beat_this.signal2spect and spect2frames only to observe inputs and returned logits; invoke original methods unchanged, exactly once per real source. Original infer performs the same upstream minimal dbn=False event postprocessing and source-domain endpoint adapter.
capture.binding: Before real inference bind exact current repository source, legacy label-free inputs, legacy 100 event records, checkpoint/upstream Python, original frozen runtime py/so files, audio hashes and original six-window coarse files. Recheck asset/runtime/audio hashes from legacy comparison freeze rather than trusting new hashes. Never parse prepared labels or scoring reports; read original coarse files for source/window geometry only. No package installation or code patching of upstream/runtime.
capture.geometry: Source 48000 Hz. Input mono length must lie between floor and ceil of source_frames*22050/48000. Introspect original MelSpectrogram n_fft=1024, hop=441, centered reflect padding; n_mels=128. Require spect rows = mono_length//441+1 and two returned f32 one-dimensional arrays with exactly this row count. Index i has upstream center i/50 seconds, corresponding exactly to source frame 960*i. This is a centered analysis coordinate, not a causal availability or zero-latency claim.
capture.coverage: Use original split_piece chunk_size1500/border6/avoid_short_end=True schedule to independently prove every spect row is assigned by aggregation after border trim. Preserve all rows, including centered final boundary/padded rows; do not infer missing data from a finite sentinel-like logit. Keep original keep_first aggregation unchanged. Check no NaN/Inf and no dropped/duplicated/reordered rows.
capture.payload: Private binary: eight-byte magic APTADN01, LE u32 row_count, LE u32 channels=2, then interleaved LE f32 beat,downbeat in original index order. Exactly 16+8*rows bytes. No sigmoid, threshold, f16, quantization, peak filtering or timestamp rounding in payload. Decode and compare exact f32 bit patterns; use decoded logits through the same upstream postprocessor and event adapter, requiring exact full event dictionaries equal both current original infer and all saved legacy events.
capture.windows: Retain all six original source S6 ranges. Map rows by source center in [first,end), separately retain centers == exclusive source end and centers > source end. Window row ownership plus boundary/beyond sets must partition every row exactly once. Centered feature support may cross source/S6 edges; do not call a center partition independent window inference or claim unsupported audio as measured silence.
capture.metadata: Private per-source metadata includes binary hash/shape, original and resampled geometry/input hashes, aggregation coverage ranges, center mapping, original events and endpoint records, saved-event parity, window row ownership, counts of nonpositive/positive logits per channel and host resources. Logit magnitude/sign is model evidence, not calibrated confidence. No label values, event correctness or grid-score computation.
capture.integrity: Freeze registration, implementation and preflight before the single clean-source capture. Refuse existing output, input/source mutation, nonfinite/shape/mapping/coverage/parity mismatch or resource-cap overrun. Preserve failed output; no parameter/endpoint/sample-rate/model rescue. Stop at first source failure; never call partial capture a complete cohort.

verification: Synthetic stdlib payload/mapping/coverage/corruption/endpoint tests plus actual pinned-runtime silent and pulse/noise capture/replay preflight, prior worker synthetic checks, unchanged native controls. After capture independently decode every payload, reconstruct centers/window ownership/coverage and replay original postprocessing against all saved events without a second model inference. Check all file hashes and complete cohort before aggregate publication.
next: Only complete capture with exact 100-source event parity allows a separately registered bounded decoder of dense beat/downbeat evidence with competing variable timing/family/phase paths. No decoder search, labels, musical scoring, model training or product/native/P4 activation in this checkpoint.
